    // The rotation about the world Z axis, right-handed.
    CreateRotationZ(_: Matrix4x4, angle: Angle): Matrix4x4 {
        var c = angle.Cos;
        var s = angle.Sin;
        return (Number4(c, s, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(-s, c, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }

    // The rotation of `angle` about `axis` (Rodrigues' formula in matrix form).
    // Precondition: `axis` is a unit vector.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix#Rotation_matrix_from_axis_and_angle
    CreateFromAxisAngle(_: Matrix4x4, axis: Vector3D, angle: Angle): Matrix4x4 {
        var x = axis.X;
        var y = axis.Y;
        var z = axis.Z;
        var sa = angle.Sin;
        var ca = angle.Cos;
        var xx = x * x; var yy = y * y; var zz = z * z;
        var xy = x * y; var xz = x * z; var yz = y * z;
        return (Number4(xx + ca * (1.0 - xx), xy - ca * xy + sa * z, xz - ca * xz - sa * y, 0.0),
                Number4(xy - ca * xy - sa * z, yy + ca * (1.0 - yy), yz - ca * yz + sa * x, 0.0),
                Number4(xz - ca * xz + sa * y, yz - ca * yz - sa * x, zz + ca * (1.0 - zz), 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }

    // The rotation matrix of a quaternion, by the doubled-component expansion.
    // Precondition: the quaternion is unit length.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
    CreateFromQuaternion(_: Matrix4x4, quaternion: Quaternion): Matrix4x4 {
        var xx = quaternion.X * quaternion.X;
        var yy = quaternion.Y * quaternion.Y;
        var zz = quaternion.Z * quaternion.Z;
        var xy = quaternion.X * quaternion.Y;
        var wz = quaternion.Z * quaternion.W;
        var xz = quaternion.Z * quaternion.X;
        var wy = quaternion.Y * quaternion.W;
        var yz = quaternion.Y * quaternion.Z;
        var wx = quaternion.X * quaternion.W;
        return (Number4(1.0 - 2.0 * (yy + zz), 2.0 * (xy + wz), 2.0 * (xz - wy), 0.0),
                Number4(2.0 * (xy - wz), 1.0 - 2.0 * (zz + xx), 2.0 * (yz + wx), 0.0),
                Number4(2.0 * (xz + wy), 2.0 * (yz - wx), 1.0 - 2.0 * (yy + xx), 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }

    // The rotation of the three Tait-Bryan angles, applied roll then pitch then
    // yaw. Built through the quaternion, as System.Numerics does, so the two
    // spellings agree bit for bit.
    CreateFromYawPitchRoll(_: Matrix4x4, yaw: Angle, pitch: Angle, roll: Angle): Matrix4x4
        => Matrix4x4.CreateFromQuaternion(Quaternion.CreateFromYawPitchRoll(yaw, pitch, roll));

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — view and world
    //
    // Right-handed, looking down -Z in view space, matching System.Numerics.

    // The view matrix of a camera at `cameraPosition` looking at `cameraTarget`.
    // The basis is built back-to-front (+Z points from the target to the camera)
    // and stored transposed, because a view matrix is the inverse of a camera
    // placement. Preconditions (unchecked): the camera is not at the target, and
    // `cameraUpVector` is not parallel to the view direction.
    CreateLookAt(_: Matrix4x4, cameraPosition: Point3D, cameraTarget: Point3D, cameraUpVector: Vector3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var zaxis = cameraTarget.Between(cameraPosition).Normalize;
        var xaxis = cameraUpVector.Cross(zaxis).Normalize;
        var yaxis = zaxis.Cross(xaxis);
        var eye = cameraPosition.PositionVector;
        return (Number4(xaxis.X, yaxis.X, zaxis.X, 0.0),
                Number4(xaxis.Y, yaxis.Y, zaxis.Y, 0.0),
                Number4(xaxis.Z, yaxis.Z, zaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(-xaxis.Dot(eye), -yaxis.Dot(eye), -zaxis.Dot(eye), 1.0));
    }

    // The world matrix that places an object at `position` facing `forward` with
    // `up` as its up direction — the inverse construction to CreateLookAt.
    // Preconditions (unchecked): `forward` is non-zero and not parallel to `up`.
    CreateWorld(_: Matrix4x4, position: Point3D, forward: Vector3D, up: Vector3D): Matrix4x4 {
        var zaxis = (-forward).Normalize;
        var xaxis = up.Cross(zaxis).Normalize;
        var yaxis = zaxis.Cross(xaxis);
        return (Number4(xaxis.X, xaxis.Y, xaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(yaxis.X, yaxis.Y, yaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(zaxis.X, zaxis.Y, zaxis.Z, 0.0),
                Number4(position.X, position.Y, position.Z, 1.0));
    }

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — projections
    //
    // All of these map the view volume onto the [-1, 1] x [-1, 1] x [0, -1]
    // clip box of the System.Numerics / DirectX convention. The C# originals
    // throw for degenerate arguments; here the preconditions are UNCHECKED (see
    // the file header). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3D_projection

    // The perspective projection of a symmetric frustum described by its
    // vertical field of view. Preconditions (unchecked):
    // 0 < fieldOfView < half a turn, 0 < nearPlane < farPlane.
    CreatePerspectiveFieldOfView(_: Matrix4x4, fieldOfView: Angle, aspectRatio: Number, nearPlane: Number, farPlane: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var yScale = 1.0 / (fieldOfView * 0.5).Tan;
        var xScale = yScale / aspectRatio;
        var range = farPlane / (nearPlane - farPlane);
        return (Number4(xScale, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, yScale, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, range, -1.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, nearPlane * range, 0.0));
    }

    // The perspective projection of a symmetric frustum described by the size of
    // its near plane. Preconditions (unchecked):
    // 0 < nearPlaneDistance < farPlaneDistance, and non-zero width and height.
    CreatePerspective(_: Matrix4x4, width: Number, height: Number, nearPlaneDistance: Number, farPlaneDistance: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var range = farPlaneDistance / (nearPlaneDistance - farPlaneDistance);
        return (Number4(2.0 * nearPlaneDistance / width, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 2.0 * nearPlaneDistance / height, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, range, -1.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, nearPlaneDistance * range, 0.0));
    }

    // The perspective projection of an arbitrary, possibly asymmetric frustum
    // given by its near-plane edges. Preconditions (unchecked):
    // 0 < nearPlaneDistance < farPlaneDistance, left != right, bottom != top.
    CreatePerspectiveOffCenter(_: Matrix4x4, left: Number, right: Number, bottom: Number, top: Number, nearPlaneDistance: Number, farPlaneDistance: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var range = farPlaneDistance / (nearPlaneDistance - farPlaneDistance);
        return (Number4(2.0 * nearPlaneDistance / (right - left), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 2.0 * nearPlaneDistance / (top - bottom), 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4((left + right) / (right - left), (top + bottom) / (top - bottom), range, -1.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, nearPlaneDistance * range, 0.0));
    }

    // The orthographic projection of a centred box.
    // Preconditions (unchecked): non-zero width, height and zFarPlane - zNearPlane.
    CreateOrthographic(_: Matrix4x4, width: Number, height: Number, zNearPlane: Number, zFarPlane: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var range = 1.0 / (zNearPlane - zFarPlane);
        return (Number4(2.0 / width, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 2.0 / height, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, range, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, zNearPlane * range, 1.0));
    }

    // The orthographic projection of an arbitrary box given by its edges.
    // Preconditions (unchecked): left != right, bottom != top, zNearPlane != zFarPlane.
    CreateOrthographicOffCenter(_: Matrix4x4, left: Number, right: Number, bottom: Number, top: Number, zNearPlane: Number, zFarPlane: Number): Matrix4x4 {
        var range = 1.0 / (zNearPlane - zFarPlane);
        return (Number4(2.0 / (right - left), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 2.0 / (top - bottom), 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, range, 0.0),
                Number4((left + right) / (left - right),
                        (top + bottom) / (bottom - top),
                        zNearPlane * range,
                        1.0));
    }
